//! Generates the task 5.3 fixture database with the Phase 0 code.
use querymt::chat::ChatRole;
use querymt_agent::events::{AgentEventKind, EventOrigin};
use querymt_agent::model::{AgentMessage, MessagePart};
use querymt_agent::session::backend::StorageBackend;
use querymt_agent::session::projection::{EventJournal, NewDurableEvent};
use querymt_agent::session::sqlite_storage::SqliteStorage;
use querymt_agent::session::store::SessionStore;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let path = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("db path");
    let storage = SqliteStorage::connect(path.into()).await.expect("connect");
    let session = storage
        .create_session(Some("fixture".into()), None, None, None)
        .await
        .expect("create session");
    println!("session_id={}", session.public_id);
    for (i, (role, text)) in [(ChatRole::User, "hello fixture"), (ChatRole::Assistant, "hi there")]
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
    {
        storage
            .add_message(
                &session.public_id,
                AgentMessage {
                    id: format!("m{i}"),
                    session_id: session.public_id.clone(),
                    role,
                    parts: vec![MessagePart::Text {
                        content: text.to_string(),
                    }],
                    created_at: 1_700_000_000 + i as i64,
                    parent_message_id: None,
                    source_provider: None,
                    source_model: None,
                },
            )
            .await
            .expect("add message");
    }
    let journal = storage.event_journal();
    for kind in [AgentEventKind::SessionCreated, AgentEventKind::Cancelled] {
        journal
            .append_durable(&NewDurableEvent {
                session_id: session.public_id.clone(),
                origin: EventOrigin::Local,
                source_node: None,
                source_node_id: None,
                source_seq: None,
                session_seq: None,
                kind,
            })
            .await
            .expect("append event");
    }
}
